home.description: I'm a Software Engineering Co-op student at Concordia University in Montréal, graduating in 2027. I've interned at Genetec, building web components for their design system, and at Intact, where I built CI/CD infrastructure as a DevOps developer. I'm now back at Intact developing their online insurance quoting flow, and since May 2026 I've been shipping recruiting tools for LH Sales Consulting on contract. In 2025 my team won first place at PolyHacks with a mobile app that identifies fish species and checks Quebec fishing regulations.

cegep.title: CÉGEP Graduation
cegep.description: Completed a DEC in Natural Sciences at Bois-de-Boulogne College.

university.title: Started University
university.description: Began a Bachelor's in Software Engineering at Concordia University in the Co-op program.

genetec.title: Software Developer Intern at Genetec
genetec.description: Built reusable web components in TypeScript and StencilJS for Genetec's design system, used by teams in HTML, React and Angular applications. Wrote Jest unit tests and Puppeteer visual regression tests, and maintained the Storybook component reference.

hackathon.title: First Hackathon: McHacks
hackathon.description: Built CasperAI, an AI-powered CASPer test prep tool using React, Node.js and the OpenAI API during McHacks 2025.

hackathonWin.title: First Hackathon Win: PolyHacks
hackathonWin.description: Won 1st place out of 47 projects at PolyHacks 2025 with AquaScan, a React Native app that identifies fish species from a photo and checks each catch against Quebec fishing regulations.

intactDevops.title: DevOps Developer Intern at Intact
intactDevops.description: Top contributor to a Node.js application other teams relied on for production releases. Built its Jira and ServiceNow integration, maintained CI/CD infrastructure across the organization, and wrote GitHub Actions workflows that built Podman images and deployed them to Kubernetes through ArgoCD.

lh.title: Software Developer, Contract at LH Sales Consulting
lh.description: Shipped a Next.js interview-debrief tool on the Gemini API that the recruiting team uses after every interview, a TypeScript Chrome extension that imports LinkedIn leads into Bigin CRM through OAuth 2.0, and Python pipelines that migrated the firm's ATS out of spreadsheets.

intactDev.title: Software Developer Intern at Intact
intactDev.description: Back at Intact for a second internship, developing the public online insurance quoting flow with Angular and Spring Boot REST services.

next.title: What's Next?
next.description: Applying for Summer 2027 software engineering internships before graduating from Concordia.

aquaScan.title: AquaScan (PolyHacks 2025 Winner)
aquaScan.description: Mobile app that identifies a fish species from a photo and checks the catch against Quebec fishing regulations. Combined image recognition with a scraper of Quebec regulations to return a legality result for each species. Won 1st place out of 47 projects.

agentHq.title: Agent HQ
agentHq.description: Self-hosted AI agent orchestration system that routes Telegram requests to Claude, Codex or local Ollama models, with agent profiles keeping credentials and permissions separate. Wrote MCP servers for GitHub, Google Drive and Outlook with OAuth token refresh, added concurrency controls, and covered it with 28 pytest modules.

openRoad.title: Open Road
openRoad.description: Driving lesson platform. Top contributor (41 of 103 commits) on a 4-person team building a Spring Boot REST API secured with Spring Security and JWT, exposing booking, matching, availability and routing endpoints. Integrated Google Maps, OSRM and HERE Transit for routing and parking discovery across Montréal, with JaCoCo and Vitest coverage.

peerReview.title: Peer Review Service
peerReview.description: Led a team of 7 to build a full-stack app for anonymous peer reviews and professor grading. Integrated state management, Agile practices and CI with Mocha/Chai tests.

paperTrading.title: Paper Trading Platform
paperTrading.description: Co-developed a MERN full-stack platform simulating U.S. equities trading with real-time market data.

casperAI.title: CasperAI (McHacks 2025)
casperAI.description: AI-powered practice tool for the CASPer test built on the OpenAI API. Delivers feedback on empathy, ethics and decision-making.

marketForecaster.title: Market Forecaster
marketForecaster.description: Tool predicting Bitcoin and S&P 500 prices using machine learning models trained on historical data.
